intro: Liora celebrates natural richness and sculptural design. Made from solid mango wood, its round top and distinctive conical base create a grounded, graceful centrepiece for contemporary living spaces.

features.title: Solid mango wood for lasting reliability
features.text: The Liora coffee table is made entirely from solid mango wood, delivering strength, stability, and reassurance for everyday living. The solid build ensures long-term durability.

features.title: Warm, earthy finish for visual comfort
features.text: The natural mango wood finish of the coffee table brings warmth and visual depth to interiors. Its subtle grain pattern and earthy hue can enhance your space with an inviting, organic character that feels grounded and thoughtfully composed.

features.title: Grandeur-Lending rounded tabletop
features.text: The smooth, circular tabletop of Liora enhances the sculptural quality of the design. Its generous proportions and refined finish lend the coffee table a composed sense of grandeur, elevating the overall look of your living space without feeling imposing.

features.title: Statement conical base
features.text: A distinctive conical understructure gives this table a bold architectural identity. This sculptural base enhances visual impact without compromising structural integrity.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
